description: An employee submits an expense. If it is over 1000, a manager reviews it; otherwise it is approved automatically. Then the payment is made. If the payment fails, notify the submitter.
diagram:
# Expense approval
start[start Expense submitted] > check[xor Amount over 1000?]
check >(Yes: amount > 1000) review[user Review expense] > pay[service Pay expense] > done[end Expense paid]
check >(No: default) auto[service Approve automatically] > pay
failed[boundary:error Payment failed | on=pay] > notify[send Notify submitter] > notice[end Payment failed]
change: After the payment, send the employee a confirmation email.
reference:
# Expense approval
start[start Expense submitted] > check[xor Amount over 1000?]
check >(Yes: amount > 1000) review[user Review expense] > pay[service Pay expense] > confirm[send Send confirmation email] > done[end Expense paid]
check >(No: default) auto[service Approve automatically] > pay
failed[boundary:error Payment failed | on=pay] > notify[send Notify submitter] > notice[end Payment failed]

description: When an order is received, validate it, process the payment and ship it.
diagram:
# Order process
start[start Order received] > validate[service Validate order] > pay[service Process payment] > ship[service Ship order] > done[end Order shipped]
change: If the payment is not confirmed within 24 hours, end the process with "Payment timed out".
reference:
# Order process
start[start Order received] > validate[service Validate order] > pay[service Process payment] > ship[service Ship order] > done[end Order shipped]
timeout[boundary:timer 24 hours passed | on=pay] > timedout[end Payment timed out]

description: When an employee is hired, they sign the contract, we order a laptop, print a badge, and they meet the team.
diagram:
# Onboarding
start[start Employee hired] > contract[user Sign contract] > laptop[service Order laptop] > badge[service Print badge] > intro[user Meet the team] > done[end Employee onboarded]
change: Remove the badge step, we don't print badges anymore.
reference:
# Onboarding
start[start Employee hired] > contract[user Sign contract] > laptop[service Order laptop] > intro[user Meet the team] > done[end Employee onboarded]

description: A customer opens a ticket. Support triages it. Urgent tickets go straight to an engineer; others are answered by support. Close the ticket when it is resolved.
diagram:
# Support ticket
start[start Ticket opened] > triage[user Triage ticket] > urgent[xor Urgent?]
urgent >(Yes: priority = "urgent") engineer[user Fix issue] > close[service Close ticket] > done[end Ticket closed]
urgent >(No: default) answer[user Answer ticket] > close
change: Tickets from VIP customers go to their account manager instead.
reference:
# Support ticket
start[start Ticket opened] > triage[user Triage ticket] > urgent[xor Urgent?]
urgent >(Yes: priority = "urgent") engineer[user Fix issue] > close[service Close ticket] > done[end Ticket closed]
urgent >(No: default) answer[user Answer ticket] > close
urgent >(VIP: customer.vip = true) manager[user Account manager handles ticket] > close

description: When an order is placed, pick the items, pack the box, print the shipping label, then dispatch the package.
diagram:
# Order fulfillment
start[start Order placed] > pick[user Pick items] > pack[user Pack box] > label[service Print shipping label] > dispatch[user Dispatch package] > done[end Package dispatched]
change: Packing the box and printing the label can happen at the same time.
reference:
# Order fulfillment
start[start Order placed] > pick[user Pick items] > fork[and]
fork > pack[user Pack box] > joined[and]
fork > label[service Print shipping label] > joined
joined > dispatch[user Dispatch package] > done[end Package dispatched]

description: Contact the customer by mail or by phone, depending on their preferred channel.
diagram:
# Contact customer
start[start Contact requested] > channel[xor Channel?]
channel >(Mail: channel = "mail") letter[send Send letter] > done[end Customer contacted]
channel >(Phone: channel = "phone") call[user Call customer] > done
reference:
# Contact customer
start[start Contact requested] > channel[xor Channel?]
channel >(Mail: default) letter[send Send letter] > done[end Customer contacted]
channel >(Phone: channel = "phone") call[user Call customer] > done

description: When an application is received, verify the applicant's identity. If verified, open the account; otherwise reject the application.
diagram:
# KYC check
start[start Application received] > verify[service Verify identity] > ok[xor Identity verified?]
ok >(Yes) open[service Open account] > done[end Account opened]
ok >(No) reject[send Reject application] > rejected[end Application rejected]
change: At "Identity verified?", decide on the verification score: above 80 is verified.
reference:
# KYC check
start[start Application received] > verify[service Verify identity] > ok[xor Identity verified?]
ok >(Yes: score > 80) open[service Open account] > done[end Account opened]
ok >(No: default) reject[send Reject application] > rejected[end Application rejected]
